prop_desc: Water development bonds (Governor Brown's water plan)
notes_endorse: YES - 'We believe Governor Edmund G. Brown's plan for water development might stand many improvements before the state assumes a [large] debt. The issue is urgent and time is of the essence.'

prop_desc: Four-year terms for state assemblymen
notes_endorse: NO - Not in accord with original concept of constitution; merely a convenience for assemblymen, not benefit of people.

prop_desc: Totally disabled veterans tax exemptions (allow exemption from one or another if entitled to no exemption at all)
notes_endorse: YES

prop_desc: Four-year terms for state college board members
notes_endorse: NO - Four-year terms long enough for any commission; would remove from administrative control.

prop_desc: Legislator salary increase
notes_endorse: NO - Legislators doing very well on $500/month plus living expenses; a 50% salary increase is an imposition on taxpayer.

prop_desc: Class legislation writing special privileges/tax matters for golf clubs into constitution

prop_desc: Chiropractic board (allow more than one member from same chiropractic college)
notes_endorse: YES

prop_desc: Allow ex-convicts to vote when their debt to society is paid

prop_desc: Streamline procedures for making claims against chartered cities and counties

prop_desc: Secret and confidential information provision
notes_endorse: NO - Against writing provision for secret and confidential information into constitution; infringes on right of people to know.

prop_desc: Tax exemptions on homes for totally disabled veterans (no future exemptions)
notes_endorse: YES - Similar to No. 5 in relation to totally disabled veterans, but a law prohibiting future tax exemptions on homes for veterans.

prop_desc: Clean-up amendment eliminating obsolete and superseded provisions in state constitution
notes_endorse: YES - Making no substantive changes.

prop_desc: Eliminate superior court step from justice to appellate
notes_endorse: NO - Would only clog up the appellate calendars.

prop_desc: Allow cities and counties to appropriate gas tax money for grade crossings construction

notes_endorse: NO - Not in accord with original concept of government; one house should represent population, other should represent area.
